limitations: Finite unweighted trees with all leaves as boundary and real functions; extensions are simple-random-walk harmonic.
The asymptotic worst-case statement is limited to spider trees, not all trees.
Potential-theoretic older literature not exhaustively checked, with the complete 2005 tree-Dirichlet article remaining uninspected.

scientific_integrity.historical_priority: Qualified; no assertion of independent historical uniqueness or completed external certification.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Finite-dimensional maximum principle, tree cut decomposition, armwise harmonic interpolation, strict convexity of reciprocal lengths, and analytic asymptotics.
scientific_integrity.reproducibility: Exact rational Gaussian Dirichlet solves and extreme-point enumerations in check_harmonic_extension.py are finite corroborations.

title: Sharp leaf-harmonic Lipschitz distortion on finite trees and spiders
